newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank offers 91-day special series.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank offers 91-day special series.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank started offering on Wednesday a 91-day special series at 9.45 percent.
Money market traders said the new offer of the Central Bank was viewed as a "test" on the banking sector's liquidity level.
"The Central Bank may also be putting a floor on the interest rate level of the 91-day Treasury-bill rate," said a senior trader at a foreign bank.
The benchmark 91-day T-bill rate slipped to an average of 9.498 percent at the regular weekly auction on Monday from 9.724 percent last week.
